khung.tieu_de: Reversed Card Depth & Elemental Dignities Across Your Spread
khung.phu_de: A reversed card is never a fixed ill omen; it signals focus turned inward, delayed timing, or pacing ready for adjustment, while neighboring card elements strengthen or temper one another through classical Elemental Dignities.
khung.cau_noi_menh_ly: Tarot mirrors present mindset and situational dynamics at the moment of drawing; for 12-month timing windows and natal structure from your birth date and hour, explore Zi Wei Dou Shu and BaZi.

pham_gia_chuoi.tuong_tro: Center card supported by friendly neighbor elements (Fire–Air or Water–Earth): its message expresses smoothly with constructive momentum.
pham_gia_chuoi.cung_nguyen_to: Adjacent cards share the exact same element: that element's theme dominates the spread — keep practical balance so it does not tip into excess.
pham_gia_chuoi.doi_nghich: Center card meets contrary elements (Fire ↔ Water or Air ↔ Earth): competing priorities pull at once; address them sequentially rather than forcing both simultaneously.
pham_gia_chuoi.trung_tinh: Center card pairs neutral elements (Fire–Earth or Water–Air): steady progress comes from pairing reflection with grounded execution.
